text:
Maya K: Heads-up: postmortem for yesterday's authz incident — token validation drift + missing audit logs. Putting remediation items here so we can confirm owners/timelines. TL;DR: validation lib had stale deps, audit forwarder misconfigured for backup region, secrets rotation queue stalled. Owners needed. Assign below.
Incident-bot: Incident #2026-314 created — https://internal/pm/314 :eyes:
Shawn L: I'll take token validation (upgrade lib + add unit tests). ETA end of next sprint — aiming for 2026-04-05. Will open PR today.
Leila: I'll handle audit forwarder config in backup region. Quick fix is restart forwarder, then config patch. Targeting 48h.
Samir: Secrets rotation queue: I can rehydrate the queue and add alerting. Need infra support for KMS perms. @Tony P can you confirm HSM access?
Tony P: Confirm HSM/KMS access for rotations. I'll open a 1-hr handoff and provide the minimal IAM role. Also will add a runbook step to verify rotation TTL.
Maya K: Thanks. Can everyone add a one-line acceptance criteria to the tracker (what 'done' looks like) and note rollback plan if needed?
Shawn L: Acceptance: tokens validated across all regions with an integration test showing 0 auth failures on 1000 simulated requests. Rollback: pin lib to 1.2.3 and block auto-upgrade. PR: https://git/repo/pull/542
Leila: Acceptance: backup-region audit logs appear in ES and S3 for 7 days. Rollback: revert forwarder endpoint config. I'll add a dashboard alert and a verification query.
Samir: Acceptance: rotation queue drained and metrics show successful rotations for 100 keys. I'll add CloudWatch alarm -> #alerts-authz. Plan: rehydrate queue, run a dry-run, then a full pass.
Katie S: Suggestion: add a weekly scheduled 'perm entropy' scan to detect drift. There's a small script at ops/tools/perm_entropy.sh — whoever owns this, can you add to cadence and a follow-up ticket?
Shawn L: I'll slot the entropy scan for next sprint as low effort.
Maya K: I'll create items in the remediation board and link PRs. Please mark status 'in progress' when you start. We'll review in Monday's ops sync. :thumbsup:
Incident-bot: Reminder set: Ops sync review scheduled 2026-03-30 10:00 UTC. Invite sent.
